content.base_revision_policy: fixed generation base; verified present and ancestor of generation/check HEAD
content.definition: non-self-referential manifest of authenticated census mathematical content; excludes census JSON bytes, orbit stream bytes and all hashes of those two files

conventions.bitset_hex: little-endian bytes; bit i is coordinate/column i
conventions.normal_section: deterministic complement of restricted quotient-sandwich intersection inside reduced kernel
conventions.obstruction_scope: computed on the displayed normal-section representative

coverage.derivative_block_circuit_definition: minimal dependence among the five reduced 46-column derivative term blocks; all five proper four-block restrictions are checked

factor_three_circuits.definition: minimal binary three-term factor dependence; all factors are nonzero and pairwise distinct

paired_t3_global.role: sufficient exact-family motif, not a classification theorem

provenance.base_revision_policy: fixed generation base; verified present and ancestor of generation/check HEAD

status_provenance.geometric: scalar-extension rank plus complete projective ideal; no sampled points promoted to geometric claims
status_provenance.linear_and_circuit: exact F2 bitset elimination from authenticated source
status_provenance.obstruction: exact F2 image/preimage or left-null certificate on displayed section
status_provenance.orbits: identity action only; every support is a singleton and no stabilizer reduction is claimed
status_provenance.solver: exact paired-T3 Laurent/formal replay when so labelled; otherwise bounded status retains unknown

singleton_orbit_records.cross_digest_definition: SHA256(classification || certificate_content || length_prefixed_body_stream), raw digest bytes
singleton_orbit_records.format: canonical JSON Lines, one identity-action singleton support orbit per line
singleton_orbit_records.integrity_model: gzip SHA256 plus complete canonical uncompressed and length-prefixed body-stream SHA256; full streaming structure/order validation by combinadic ID

row_authentication.meaning: non-self-referential digest of the census certificate content manifest; repeated by every row

source.fixture_role: sole input opened by generator and checker

summary.Fbar_direction_classification: exact for normal dimension one; full quadratic ideals emitted for larger dimensions
summary.exact_integrability_statement_scope: normal classes; raw deterministic sections are never identified with canonical T3 tangents without the stored comparison
summary.linear_scalar_extension_scope: all ranks, kernel dimensions, gauge-intersection dimensions, and normal dimensions are unchanged over every characteristic-two field; projective point sets are not thereby identified

unknowns: No stabilizer or orbit reduction is claimed or used.
Paired-T3 is sufficient and is not assumed complete before the exhaustive rank result is read.
For normal dimension greater than one, emitted projective quadratic ideals are not declared geometrically solved.
A bounded successful Hasse lift is not an all-order integrability result.
F2 bounded higher lifting does not classify Fbar2 higher lifting unless an exact family or scalar-extended obstruction certificate is present.
